name: Multiple External Products URLs & Currencies for WooCommerce
author: WPFactory

sections.description:
Multiple External Products URLs & Currencies for WooCommerce plugin gives you more control over external (i.e., affiliate) products in WooCommerce.

✅ Main Features

  • Set different currency for external products in WooCommerce. For example, if your shop’s default currency is Euros (EUR), you can set your external (i.e., affiliate) products to display prices in United States Dollars (USD). You can also set custom currency symbol for the external products.
  • Make external product link open in a new tab.
  • Set multiple URLs per product.

🏆 Premium Version

With the premium plugin version, you can:

  • Set different currency on a per-product basis.
  • Make external product link open in a new tab on a per-product basis.
  • Use dropdown template for the “Multiple URLs”.

🗘 Feedback

  • We are open to your suggestions and feedback. Thank you for using or trying out one of our plugins!
  • Visit plugin site.

ℹ More

  • The plugin is “High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)” compatible.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Start by visiting plugin settings at “WPFactory > Advanced External Products”.
